notes.title: AimX 1.1.0
notes.content:
Improved user interface structure and visuals

New "Play and Improve" section: A personalized system that suggests drills based on your aim profile, current form and preferences.

Advanced settings added:
	- Menu sound effects volume 
	- Target volume 
	- Weapon volume
	- Hide/Show weapon
	- Switch weapon side
	- Quick restart key
